items.title: On Black Friday, a new global campaign asks Amazon’s paying customers to stand with the workers who pick, pack and deliver their orders
items.summary: Through makeamazonfair.org, the campaign invites Prime members to stand with Amazon workers around the world who are demanding dignity and respect at work. The post On Black Friday, a new global campaign asks Amazon’s paying customers to stand with the workers who pick, pack and deliver their orders appeared first on UNI Global Union .

items.title: Korean agricultural finance union rallies against forced relocation of NongHyup headquarters
items.summary: An estimated 5,000 workers rallied in Gwanghwamun, Seoul, on 26 November 2026, according to the organizers. They oppose moving the headquarters of the National Agricultural Cooperative Federation (NACF) and its affiliates out of Seoul. The rally was organized by the NH NongHyup Branch of the Korea Finance Industry Union (KFIU), a UNI Global Union affiliate. The post Korean agricultural finance union rallies against forced relocation of NongHyup headquarters appeared first on UNI Global Union .

items.title: Corporate Credit Unions
items.summary: The NCUA Board (Board) is amending its regulations for corporate credit unions by removing the requirement that a corporate credit union's asset and liability management committee (ALCO) must have at least one member who is also a member of the corporate credit union's board of directors. The final rule also removes filing requirements related to a corporate credit union's annual report and any management letter or other report issued by its independent public accountant. The intended effect is to reduce unnecessary regulatory burden and provide corporate credit unions with greater flexibility.
